simple.meaning: נִחוּם (nichûwm) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, consoled ; abstractly, solace.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נִחוּם (H5150) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 57:18, with occurrences in Isaiah, Hosea, Zechariah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נִחוּם (H5150) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נִחוּם (H5150) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נִחוּם (nichûwm) / H5150 is traced through Isaiah 57:18, Hosea 11:8, Zechariah 1:13 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
